**Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150**

**Top picks**
- **Best value: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, $149.99.** SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10, and its noise cancelling beat 63% of the earbuds it measured. It has LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5 water resistance, and gets about 5h42m per charge with ANC on ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)). Dealectric tested code **AFSC20** in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, and it brought the price to about **$120**. The code expires 2026-12-31 and doesn't work on sale items ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-discount-codes)). [Buy at Soundcore's store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. Checkout has the final word on the code.
- **Best ANC on any phone: Nothing Ear (3), just under $150 on Amazon.** SoundGuys scored its ANC 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging, but the sound is bass-heavy, the mics are muffled on calls, and you get about 5 hours per charge with ANC ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- **Best for Samsung and Android: Galaxy Buds3 Pro, about $134 on Amazon from Samsung's official store.** They have strong adaptive ANC, IPX7 and up to 18 hours of battery with the case ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- **Best Sony: WF-C710N, about $119 at Walmart** ($128 at Best Buy or Sweetwater). What Hi-Fi? named it best budget, praising its fulsome, controlled bass ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)).

**Other options**
- **Cheapest: Soundcore P31i, $59.99.** It has adaptive ANC, multipoint and IP55. The ANC isn't class-leading, but it's solid for the price ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- **iPhone users:** The AirPods 5 are $129 (or $149 with a wireless charging case). Their open fit can't block as much noise as sealed buds. Apple's AirPods Pro 2 are no longer sold new, but renewed pairs go for around $150 on sale and have excellent ANC ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- **Pixel users:** The Pixel Buds 2a are $129 with ANC and up to 7 hours per charge ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).

**My pick:** If you want the strongest ANC for the money, get the Liberty 4 Pro with the code, or the Galaxy Buds3 Pro if you're on Samsung. For a Sony at a lower price, get the WF-C710N.

I only had a direct purchase link for the Liberty 4 Pro. For the others, the linked reviews show current retailer prices, which change often, so check before you buy.
